workflows.name: multyr-core-v2
notes: September 25 deployment; weekly means Monday 00:00 UTC, not 7 days from activation.
A single check selects one operation. Enable a reviewed catch-up schedule or use separate fast reserve maintenance; weekly checks alone cannot guarantee queue progress.

workflows.name: multyr-lending-v2
notes: Daily 00:00 UTC. APY priority can starve later work without catch-up; verify pokeInterval and plan expiry.
One write per run; receipt success is not proof that harvested/rebalanced state advanced.

workflows.name: multyr-claims
notes: Continuous polling catches funded epochs and retries; default local upkeep batch is 20 claims, verify deployed values.
Pays recorded claim owners through the deployed claim upkeep.

workflows.name: multyr-fees
notes: Weekly distribution plus ten-minute queued cleanup are separate handlers in one slot.
AUTO_HARVEST must be configured where intended. Preflight rejects an unready queue; errors are reported, never treated as payouts.
Direct FeeCollector calls; no nonexistent FeeCollectorUpkeep address. Add approved underlying token distributions if required.

workflows.name: multyr-liquidity
notes: Seven bounded batch handlers in ONE workflow slot; seven executions every five minutes if all enabled.
Ranges index the CURRENT ENABLED adapter list, not deployment order. Verify membership and remove unused handlers before enabling live mode.
Each handler submits at most one report. Gas must fit the worst funded adapter, including receiver overhead.

workflows.name: multyr-warm-nav
notes: Five-minute proposed refresh against historical 600-second interval; verify actual thresholds and need.
Permissionless refresh; transaction delivery is not proof of valid NAV, use monitoring. Can be merged with another data-maintenance workflow.

workflows.name: multyr-monitor
notes: Structured CRE logs and returned observations only; wire external alert delivery separately.
Baseline 11 observations, not exhaustive telemetry of all 40 contracts. Read errors are explicit. No policy writes.
Paused=true is expected during shadow setup; adjust expectations only after review.

workflows.name: multyr-position-sync
notes: PARAM_ROLE required; existing rebalance/deploy paths already sync. Choose drift policy before adding writes.
Enforced preview-only by engine: live mode is rejected. Enable individual preview actions only after replacing placeholders.

workflows.name: multyr-adapter-accrual
notes: Venus accrual is permissionless. Morpho refresh is onlyVault and cannot be called directly by a CRE receiver; implement/verify a routed forwarding path.
Enforced preview-only by engine: live mode is rejected. Enable individual preview actions only after replacing placeholders.
